hooks.name: Block catastrophic irreversible actions
hooks.description: Denies the short list of actions that cannot be undone, so blanket allow permissions stay defensible: rm/shred/truncate on / $HOME ~/.aws ~/.ssh ~/.kiro or the repo root, any destruction of the retained plaintext credential source, truncation of ~/.aws/credentials, chmod widening on protected files, disk-level writes, and aws secretsmanager get-secret-value (forbidden by aws-agent-rules steering). Asks before destructive AWS deletes, which project steering already requires pointwise confirmation for.

action.command: D=/Users/wecaredigital/wecare-store; if [ -x "$D/.venv/bin/python" ]; then exec "$D/.venv/bin/python" "$D/scripts/block_catastrophic.py"; else exec /usr/bin/python3 "$D/scripts/block_catastrophic.py"; fi
